description:
The second research tutorial takes a researcher through large-scale linear algebra over finite fields with gf2-core.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/tutorials/` walks through building large matrices over a prime and an extension field, choosing the field representation, and running multiplication, PLE-based solving and an inverse or characteristic polynomial at scale.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its code comes from the gf2-core field linear-algebra example program and is verified by running it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Its prose is freshly authored and contains no elementary primer, history, future promises or performance figures.
- [hard] REQ-04: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links resolve.
title: Write the finite-field linear algebra at scale tutorial
